Reintroducing

Satwik Girish Vaidya

these photographs are not in a hurry. neither should you be.

scroll

the world kept moving.

they didn't notice.

the conversation neither of them had to start.

not for loud pleasure.

for a silent duty.

before the prayers were said. before anyone was fed.

the morning was already being made by hand.

he didn't have to say what it cost.

the building was already saying it.

the lens flare was an accident.

it stayed because she did.

for the moments of the soul.

all photographs, lighting, direction, and editing — Satwik Vaidya, alone.

— end —
